extras.real_size: pepperoni pizza, 30 cm diameter, 2.5 cm high at the crust
extras.notes: cut into 8 slices with visible layers at the cuts (dough, tomato sauce, melted cheese); salami slices, black olive rings, basil leaves; the front slice 'pizza_slice' is a separate object pulled out 3 cm towards -Y (translate +Y 3 cm to close the gap, its origin lies on the slice tip); no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
